bootDialog.title: Reboot on snapshot #{id}?
bootDialog.hint: The box reboots on this snapshot, in rescue mode, read-only. It stays offline for 1 to 3 minutes.

rescue.title: Rescue mode
rescue.hint: The system is booted from a previous snapshot. It is read-only: nothing is saved on the disk. You can make this snapshot the primary read-write system: the box will reboot.

rollbackDialog.title: Roll back to snapshot #{id}?
rollbackDialog.hint: This snapshot becomes the primary system: changes made since are lost. The box reboots.

normalDialog.title: Return to normal system?
normalDialog.hint: The box reboots on the primary system. Anything done in rescue mode is lost.

empty.title: No snapshots
empty.hint: No previous version is available on this box.

unreachable.title: Cannot reach the admin service
unreachable.hint: The box is not answering. Check that it is powered on, then retry.

tooOld.title: Feature unavailable
tooOld.hint: This box's admin service is too old to manage snapshots. Update the box.

snapper.title: Snapper unavailable
snapper.hint: The snapshot list cannot be read on this box.

upgrading.title: Update in progress
upgrading.hint: Snapshots are unavailable during the update. Actions come back afterwards.

rebooting.title: Rebooting
rebooting.hint: The box is rebooting. This page reconnects by itself, allow 1 to 3 minutes.

unknown.title: Waiting for the box
unknown.hint: The box did not confirm the request. It may be rebooting: this page checks again by itself. Do not send the request twice.
